raw_response:
The cause is duplicate rows in raw_merchants. Six merchant_ids appear twice, and the copies are identical in every column. The join in gold_mcc_daily therefore fans out and inflates the counts (5416 vs 4699). Deduplicating the merchant dimension fixes this with no ambiguity.

The fix is to change silver_merchants to use SELECT DISTINCT. Since the copies are fully identical, DISTINCT is safe. Grouping by merchant_id and picking one mcc would also work, but DISTINCT is simpler and keeps the same columns.

The other tables are unaffected. gold_merchant_daily and gold_customer_spend use silver_transactions only, and silver_customers has no duplicates.
